review_method: Human user judgments following assistant-presented English QA/source excerpts, full abstracts for not-stated cases, Chinese translations and occasional field-specific prompts. Full source abstracts and all fields were available in qa_audit_review_50.md.
limitations: Single reviewer; model-assisted and not blinded. Excerpts and field prompts may influence attention, translations may contain errors, and rare errors may be missed. The interval covers sampling uncertainty under the approximation, not reviewer error. No detected E1–E5/E7 errors does not prove their absence. Assessment concerns grounding in abstracts, not scientific truth.

not_stated_template_concentration.note: Not-stated questions showed template concentration around duration-related missing information: six of the seven not-stated questions in the audited sample ask about an unreported growth or deposition duration; the remaining question asks about numerical uncertainty. This limits coverage of different missing-information types and may make abstention evaluation less diverse. This is a dataset-level limitation, not an additional pair-level error assigned by the reviewer.
